offering_description.value: Manufactures residential and commercial roofing shingles and underlayment, insulation products, and glass fiber reinforcements and composites. Sells to contractors, builders, distributors, home centers and industrial manufacturers, producing in its own plants worldwide.

primary_products.value: asphalt roofing shingles; building insulation (fiberglass, foam, mineral wool); glass fiber reinforcements; composite materials; manufactured stone veneer

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing contractors, homebuilders, building product distributors, home centers, industrial composite manufacturers; B2C: homeowners buying roofing and insulation via contractors and retailers

end_markets.value: residential construction; roofing replacement; commercial construction; wind energy; transportation and industrial composites

revenue_model.value: product sales: roofing, insulation and composite products sold to distributors, retailers, contractors and manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts asphalt, glass, minerals and chemicals into building and composite products sold to distributors, retailers and industrial customers

geography_served.value: global: North America primarily, plus Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: roofing, insulation and composites segments sharing building-materials manufacturing and channels

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: building product and roofing distributors; third-party retail: home improvement centers; direct sales: industrial composite customers and contractor programs
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, emissions, workplace safety and building code/product standards rules (EPA, OSHA)
